The user can't change the value; the form still submits it. Barred
from validation, as a native control: `required` doesn't apply.
Reflected to `readonly`: the browser reads the attribute.

declarations.description:
Mixin: Attaches `ElementInternals` and exposes it as `this.internals`.

`attachInternals()` can only be called once per element, so any component
that needs form participation (`internals.form`, `setFormValue`, validity)
or `:state()` custom states should apply this mixin and read `this.internals`
— never call `this.attachInternals()` directly.
declarations.name: withInternals

members.name: customStates
members.default: { set: (name: string, active: boolean) => { if (!supportsCustomStates || !this.internals?.states) { return; } if (active) { this.internals.states.add(name); } else { this.internals.states.delete(name); } }, has: (name: string): boolean => { if (!supportsCustomStates || !this.internals?.states) { return false; } return this.internals.states.has(name); }, }
members.description:
Wraps `internals.states` so components can toggle `:state(x)` selectors
(e.g. `:state(open)`) instead of reflecting extra boolean attributes.
A no-op where `:state()` is unsupported (see `supportsCustomStates`), so
`:state()` styling must stay an enhancement — reflect an attribute too
when the state is needed for the component to look right.

members.name: invokerControl
members.description: The native `<button>` that sends the command.

declarations.description:
Mixin: makes a component that renders a native `<button>` an invoker, as
`<button commandfor command>` is (Invoker Commands). The component takes
`commandfor` and `command`, and hands them to its native button: the
browser sends the command, runs the built-in ones on a native `<dialog>`
or popover, and retargets `event.source` to the host.

Where Invoker Commands are missing, the first component with a `command`
loads invokers-polyfill.
declarations.name: withInvoker

members.name: commandFor
members.description:
`id` of the element the button controls, in the button's tree: the
document, or the shadow root the button is rendered in. Needs `command`.

members.name: command
members.description:
Command sent on click: a built-in one for a native `<dialog>` or
popover (`show-modal`, `close`, `toggle-popover`…), or a custom one,
prefixed with `--`, for a component (`--show-modal` for `modal`).

members.name: commandForElement
members.description:
The element the button controls. Takes precedence over `commandfor`,
and reaches an element of an enclosing shadow root, like the native
property.

members.name: invokerControl
members.description:
The native `<button>` that sends the command: the first `button` of the
shadow root. Override it when the template renders another one first.

members.name: #target
members.description: `commandForElement`, or the element `commandfor` names in the host's tree.

members.name: #sync
members.description: Hands the command and its target to the native button. Returns the target.

attributes.name: commandfor

document, or the shadow root the button is rendered in. Needs `command`.

attributes.name: command

popover (`show-modal`, `close`, `toggle-popover`…), or a custom one,
prefixed with `--`, for a component (`--show-modal` for `modal`).

declarations.name: cssAnchors
declarations.description: Whether the browser positions an element against an anchor in CSS.

declarations.name: supportsPopover
declarations.description: Whether the Popover API exists: a popover reaches the top layer.

declarations.name: loadAnchorFallback
declarations.description: Loads Floating UI once. Call it only where `cssAnchors()` is false.

declarations.name: nativeInvokers
declarations.description: The browser's own Invoker Commands, not the polyfill's: read before any loading.

declarations.name: invokersReady

Whether `HTMLButtonElement.commandForElement` exists, native or polyfilled.
Never assign it before: an own property would hide the polyfill's accessor

declarations.name: loadInvokers
declarations.description: Loads the polyfill once, where Invoker Commands are missing. Resolves at once elsewhere.

declarations.name: parseDate
declarations.description: The date of a `YYYY-MM-DD` text, or `undefined` for another text or an impossible date.

declarations.name: formatDate
declarations.description: The `YYYY-MM-DD` text of a date.

declarations.name: daysInMonth
declarations.description: The number of days of a month.

declarations.name: compareDates
declarations.description: Negative when `a` comes before `b`, 0 on the same day, positive after.

declarations.name: dayOfWeek
declarations.description: The day of the week: 0 for Sunday, 6 for Saturday.

declarations.name: addDays
declarations.description: The date `days` later, or earlier when negative.

declarations.name: addMonths
declarations.description: The same day `months` later, or earlier: the last day of a shorter month.

declarations.name: isWithin
declarations.description: Whether `date` lies within `min` and `max`, either of them optional.

declarations.name: clampDate
declarations.description: `date` brought back within `min` and `max`.

declarations.name: monthWeeks
declarations.description:
The weeks of a month, from the week of its first day to the week of its
last, each starting on `firstDay` (0 for Sunday, 1 for Monday). A day of
an adjacent month is `undefined`: the grid leaves its cell empty.

declarations.name: calendarKeyMove
declarations.description:
The date a key moves the focus to, from `date`, as in the ARIA date
picker: the arrows by a day or a week, Home and End to the start or end
of the week, PageUp and PageDown by a month, or a year with Shift.
`undefined` for another key.

declarations.name: enabledIndexes
declarations.description: The indexes of the items the user can reach.

declarations.name: moveIndex
declarations.description:
The index of the active item after a move, -1 for none: the next or
previous enabled item, looping at the ends, or the first or last enabled
one. Without an enabled item, none is active.

declarations.name: collectionKeyMove
declarations.description: The move of a key in a collection. `undefined` for a key that doesn't move.

declarations.name: closedCombobox
declarations.description: A combobox at rest: closed, no active item.

declarations.name: comboboxReducer
declarations.description:
The state after `event`. Returns `state` itself when nothing changes.

The popup opens only when the combobox is enabled and has content. Closed,
it has no active item.

declarations.name: formatNumber
declarations.description:
The number `value`, in the format of HTML (`"1250.5"`), as `options` show
it in `language`: `"1 250,50 €"`. `""` for `""`, the text itself for a
text that isn't a number.

declarations.name: editableNumber
declarations.description:
The text the user edits: the number in `language`, without groups nor
symbols, a percentage times a hundred: `"1250,5"`, `"25"` for 25 %.

declarations.name: parseNumber
declarations.description:
The number a user wrote in `language`, in the format of HTML: `"1250.5"`
for `"1 250,50 €"`. `""` for an empty text, `undefined` for a text that
isn't a number. A percentage reads a hundred times smaller.

declarations.name: stepNumber
declarations.description:
The value after one step up (`1`) or down (`-1`), within the bounds and on
the step from `min`, as ArrowUp and ArrowDown do on a native number input.
From an empty value, the first step gives `min`, or else 0.

declarations.name: paginationItems
declarations.description:
The items of a pagination at `page` among `pages`: every page when they
fit in `2 × siblings + 5` items, otherwise the first and last pages, the
`siblings` pages on each side of the current one, and a gap between. A
gap never stands for a single page: that page shows instead.

declarations.name: orderedValues
declarations.description: `values` in the order of `items`, without the values of no item.

declarations.name: toggleValue
declarations.description:
Chooses `value` if it isn't chosen, or leaves it out if it is, in the order
of `items`. A disabled item doesn't change: the same array comes back.

declarations.name: toggleAll
declarations.description:
Chooses every enabled item, or none of them when they are all chosen
already: a "select all" box. The disabled items keep their choice.

declarations.name: nextSort
declarations.description:
The sort after a press on the header of column `key`: the other
direction on the column already sorting, ascending on another one.

declarations.name: sortRows
declarations.description:
A copy of `rows`, objects, sorted by their value at `sort.key`. Numbers and dates
compare as such, the rest as text in the order of `locale`, with its
numbers in it ("item 2" before "item 10"). Empty values go last. Equal
rows keep their order.

declarations.name: emptyToastQueue
declarations.description: No message.

declarations.name: addToast

type.text: { queue: ToastQueue; toast: Toast; dropped: readonly Toast[] }

declarations.description:
Adds a message, with the next id. Past `max` messages, the oldest ones
leave the queue: `dropped` holds them.

declarations.name: removeToast
declarations.description: Removes the message `id`. The same queue when it isn't there.

declarations.name: visibleNodes
declarations.description: The nodes that show, in reading order: the roots, and the children of the expanded ones.

declarations.name: parentOf
declarations.description: The parent of `node`, `undefined` for a root or a node outside the tree.

declarations.name: emptyTypeahead
declarations.description: No text typed.

declarations.name: TYPEAHEAD_DELAY
declarations.description: How long the typed text lasts after a key, in milliseconds.

declarations.name: normalizeText
declarations.description: Text compared without case nor accents: "év" matches "Évry".

declarations.name: isTypeaheadKey

type.text: { key: string; altKey: boolean; ctrlKey: boolean; metaKey: boolean }

declarations.description: Whether a key types a character for typeahead. Space only continues a typed text: alone, it picks.

declarations.name: typeahead
declarations.description:
Adds `key`, typed at `time`, to the typed text, and finds the item it
leads to: the first enabled item whose label starts with the text, after
the active one when the text is a single character, looping. The same
character typed again moves to the next item that starts with it. -1 when
no item matches.

declarations.name: baseVersion
declarations.description:
The version of `@unicorne/components`. A registration carries it: two
copies of the base on a page can tell their versions apart (ADR 0012).
